ns2:section.sectionText: ON-CAMPUS PROGRAM UNDERGRADUATE STUDENTS SECTION B. Asynchronous online. No synchronous class meeting time/day. Canvas LMS. Enrollment restrictions notation: No late adds after start of first class without prior written permission of the professor at bmbarnet@illinois.edu. No Audits, Sit-in, Credit/No Credit, or Non-Degree enrollments. Restricted to on-campus program Juniors and Seniors with Degree status for 3 hours credit. Not for students with Freshman, Sophomore, Undergraduate Non-Degree, Graduate, or Graduate Non-Degree class standing.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman, Sophomore, or Und Non-Degree class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
